rationale: CROSS-EDUCATOR. Alex G marks highs and lows at candle BODIES and states explicitly 'not at the wick'. TJR (source #2) marks a high at the highest WICK of the two candles forming it. Both are describing the same operation -- locating a structure point -- and prescribe incompatible price levels. This changes every downstream value: where the level sits, whether a break has occurred, stop placement, and risk-to-reward. Recorded, not resolved.
